name: theme-examples
description: Local build of Anthropic's theme-examples 0.4.3: backdrops behind the chat in the Claude desktop app, with a default wallpaper (a Suzhou garden: a round gate and a Taihu stone, a pavilion by the water) that follows the system's light or dark appearance. /custom-theme list names the themes. Wallpapers of your own go in ~/.claude/wallpapers (ask Claude to make one: the make-wallpaper skill).

author.name: Anthropic, with local changes by Justaboringname
